listings.description: Imperial Ocean is a refreshing woody-aquatic fragrance inspired by the vitality of the sea. Sparkling bergamot and ginger mingle with sea salt for a crisp, invigorating opening. The heart reveals marine seaweed, earthy vetiver, and delicate lily of the valley, while ambergris and cedarwood provide a smooth, elegant finish..

Spirito Ignite is a captivating woody-fruity fragrance with a refined leathery signature. The opening blends powdery iris with the playful sweetness of popcorn and a spark of pink pepper. At its heart, elegant florals intertwine with a supple leathery accord, creating depth and sophistication. The base lingers with soft violet and smooth leather nuances, leaving a bold and memorable trail..

Eclipse Extrait Nova is a delectable gourmand-powdery fragrance that opens with juicy cherry and raspberry enlivened by pink peppercorn. The heart unfolds with velvety violet and a delicious cooked sugar accord softened by cedarwood. A sensual base of vanilla and dry amber leaves a warm, addictive trail..

Eclipse Extrait is a luminous citrus-woody fragrance accented with aromatic spices. Mandarin and sparkling hesperidic notes merge with fresh aromatics and spices to create an energetic opening. The heart of neroli, black tea, and honey adds elegance and warmth, while cedarwood, guaiacwood, and olibanum form a sophisticated, resinous base..

Spirito Mystic is a sensual woody-oriental fragrance that opens with the timeless elegance of rose, brightened by bergamot and warmed by cardamom. The heart reveals creamy sandalwood and tonka bean wrapped in a soft powdery accord. A velvety base of patchouli, musk, and vanilla leaves an alluring and enduring impression. .

Jasmere is an elegant floral-woody fragrance that captures the delicate beauty of blooming petals wrapped in soft musky warmth. It opens with luminous linden blossom, rich jasmine sambac, and broom, creating a fresh yet creamy floral introduction. The heart unfolds with heliotrope, vetiver, and orange blossom, adding powdery softness and subtle earthy depth. The base of dry woods and musk provides a smooth, comforting finish that lingers gracefully on the skin..

Le Falcon Dubai is a bold oriental-balsamic fragrance that captures the mystique and richness of the Middle East. It opens with a striking blend of pink peppercorn and saffron, delivering a spicy and luxurious introduction. The heart unfolds with aromatic artemisia and modern Mahonial™, adding a refined floral-green nuance. The base is deep and captivating, built on incense, Mystikal™, cedarwood, and akigalawood™, creating a smoky, woody, and long-lasting signature that exudes power and sophistication..

Le Falcon is a bold woody-aromatic fragrance enriched with warm spices and smooth ambered depth. It opens with a vibrant blend of mandarin, cardamom, pink pepper, and saffron, delivering a fresh yet spicy introduction. The heart reveals a warm fusion of nutmeg, cinnamon, and dry amber, adding richness and intensity. The base settles into a refined trail of light tobacco, vanilla, sandalwood, and a leathery accord, creating a smooth, masculine, and long-lasting signature..

Platine Blanc Aromatix is a refined aromatic fragrance that captures the essence of fresh herbs and crisp citrus. It opens with a revitalizing burst of mint, lemon, basil, and thyme, delivering an immediate sense of clarity and energy. At its heart, a soothing blend of black currant, rosemary, lavender, and jasmine adds a floral complexity and green herbal depth. The base settles into a clean and comforting finish of musk and vervain, leaving behind a gentle yet lasting trail. Ideal for those who enjoy clean, botanical, and sophisticated scents, Platine Blanc Aromatix is perfect for daily wear, especially in warmer seasons. Whether for home ambiance or personal use, this fragrance brings a breath of fresh air wherever it’s worn. .

Nabatieh is a rich oriental-gourmand fragrance that blends warm spices with indulgent sweetness and smoky woods. The opening features cardamom, cinnamon, and almond, creating a spicy yet creamy introduction. The heart unfolds with dates, coffee, orris, and vanilla, delivering a deep, addictive gourmand character with elegant floral softness. The base settles into tonka bean, cedarwood, smoky notes, and akigalawood, leaving a warm, woody, and long-lasting trail that feels bold and luxurious. .

Fierte is a bold, spicy scent with lively black and pink pepper, softened by a rich fusion of olibanum and saffron. It finishes with smooth bourbon vanilla, suede, and cedar, creating a refined, elegant aroma. .

Ripple is a refined woody-aromatic fragrance inspired by cool ocean breezes and smooth woody depth. It opens with fresh bergamot, calming lavender, and aromatic sage, creating a crisp and elegant introduction. The heart flows into marine and watery accords blended with cedarwood and sandalwood, adding clean freshness with a subtle woody character. The base settles into musk, incense, and dry amber, leaving a smooth, modern, and long-lasting trail that feels effortlessly sophisticated. .

Inspired By The Charishma And Sex Appeal Of 007 James Bond, Spectre Ghost Has A Spicy, Fresh Start With A Hint Of Citrus, Leading To A Sweet, Floral Heart And Settling Into A Warm, Comforting Blend With A Touch Of Muskiness. .

Liquid Brun – Limited Edition is a refined fougère-oriental fragrance wrapped in warm amber elegance. It opens with a fresh citrus lift blended with aromatic lavender and spicy cardamom, creating a clean yet captivating introduction. The heart reveals a smooth floral-woody balance of orange blossom, rose, and guaiacwood, adding depth and sophistication. The base settles into a rich, masculine trail of dry amber, vanilla, tonka bean, and oakmoss, delivering warmth, sensuality, and lasting presence. .

Ravine Ice is a crisp and refreshing citrus-aromatic fragrance inspired by clean air and cool landscapes. It opens with a sharp burst of lemon and fresh geranium, delivering instant brightness and energy. The heart introduces aromatic sage and lavender blended with subtle salty notes, creating a modern, breezy freshness. The base of moss, cedarwood, and ambroxan adds a cool woody depth, leaving a clean, long-lasting, and effortlessly masculine trail. .

Ravine Ginger is a vibrant and uplifting fragrance that blends sparkling citrus with spicy warmth and a smooth woody-amber base. The opening is fresh and energetic with ginger, lemon, and bergamot, delivering a crisp and zesty start. The heart reveals a soft floral bouquet of orange blossom, magnolia, jasmine, and rose, adding elegance and balance. The base unfolds into a comforting blend of vanilla, amber, sandalwood, cashmere woods, patchouli, and musk, leaving a warm, refined, and long-lasting trail. .

Grow is a rich and comforting woody-gourmand fragrance that blends warm spices, creamy sweetness, and refined woods. It opens with an exotic mix of saffron, date accord, davana essence, Timur pepper, and juicy pear, creating a vibrant yet indulgent introduction. The heart reveals a luscious custard date accord layered with geranium, rose, sandalwood, muguet, peony, and jasmine, adding floral elegance and creamy depth. The base settles into a deep, long-lasting trail of Atlas cedarwood, cypriol, labdanum resin, tonka absolute, vanilla, musk, dry woods, and immortelle, leaving a smooth, enveloping, and addictive signature. .

listings.rawTitle: Liquid Brun & Aromatix Naughty Dates Duo

listings.description: Sh’mallow Fluff is a joyful floriental-gourmand creation that opens with a burst of bright lemon, crisp apple, juicy strawberry jam, and the tropical smoothness of coconut. At its heart, delicate orange blossom and jasmine are wrapped in the pillowy sweetness of marshmallow, creating an irresistible candy-like charm. The fragrance lingers with a warm, comforting base of vanilla, musk, ambrox, and indulgent praline, leaving behind a trail that is both playful and enchanting. A deliciously whimsical scent for those who embrace their sweet side. .

X Xandal is a captivating gourmand fragrance that wraps you in the indulgent warmth of vanilla in all its forms. This Amber-Vanilla scent opens with a luxurious blend of Madagascar Vanilla, Bourbon Vanilla, and Vanilla Caviar, offering a creamy, sweet introduction. The heart reveals an irresistible fusion of rich chocolate truffle, warm rum, earthy patchouli, and soft jasmine — evoking depth and sensuality. As it settles, the base unveils a decadent trail of Vanilla Absolute, caramelized Tonka Bean, luscious caramel, and smoky agarwood. X Xandal is made for those who crave elegance with a sweet edge — a perfect signature scent for both day and night. .

Aromatix Frostbite is a vibrant and modern fragrance that fuses juicy fruits with aromatic florals and deep woody ambers. The opening bursts with mango, bergamot, blueberry, apple, and a touch of cardamom, creating a fresh yet slightly spicy introduction. The heart unfolds with lavender, pink pepper, jasmine, geranium, violet, and vetiver, adding aromatic depth and elegance. The base is rich and long-lasting, blending oakmoss, amber, ambergris, vanilla, sandalwood, cedarwood, and patchouli for a smooth, powerful, and confident finish. .

listings.rawTitle: Alter Ego Duo - Liquid Brun & Spectre Ghost

listings.description: 8TH WONDER is a bold and intoxicating oriental fragrance that blends spicy freshness with rich boozy sweetness and deep resins. The opening sparkles with cardamom and pink pepper, balanced by the juicy glow of glazed apple. The heart reveals an indulgent fusion of date liquor accord, davana, osmanthus absolute, and boozy notes, creating a luxurious and addictive character. The base settles into a powerful resinous trail of myrrh, styrax, patchouli, benzoin, labdanum, and amberxtrem, leaving a warm, intense, and unforgettable impression. .

Western Shisha is an intriguing oriental-spicy fragrance that blends sweet, smoky, and warm notes for a unique and captivating experience. The top notes of bubblegum grape, davana, and olibanum create a playful yet exotic opening. The heart combines jasmine, rum, and a shisha accord, adding depth, aromatic richness, and a hint of indulgence. The base of patchouli and vanilla provides a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish that lingers seductively on the skin. .

Hypnotic Gold is a rich oriental-vanilla fragrance that entices with a blend of spicy, sweet, and floral notes. The top opens with vibrant rosemary, black pepper, saffron, and a playful hint of cotton candy. The heart unveils a luxurious mix of freesia, cinnamon, jasmine, rose, orris, and honey, adding depth and sophistication. The base of musk, cypriol, tonka, cashmere, vanilla, and styrax provides a warm, creamy, and long-lasting finish, leaving a hypnotic and memorable trail. .

Cosmic Tonka is a luxurious oriental-woody fragrance that combines sparkling spices, rich florals, and deep warm woods. The top notes of bergamot and saffron create a bright, invigorating opening. The heart unfolds with the sophisticated blend of agarwood and Bulgarian rose, adding floral elegance and complexity. The base of white musk, tonka bean, amber, and oakmoss provides a warm, sensual, and long-lasting finish, leaving a refined and captivating trail. .

Marmara is a refined and modern fragrance that blends spicy freshness with soft, musky woods. It opens with the vibrant sparkle of Italian bergamot, accented by the warmth of black pepper and saffron. The heart reveals a smooth fusion of cashmere wood, ambroxan, and a delicate powdery accord, adding depth and elegance. The base settles into a clean and comforting trail of musk and white sandalwood, creating a sophisticated and long-lasting impression. .

Colloseum is a bold fruity-oriental fragrance that blends juicy sweetness with warm, opulent depth. It opens with an indulgent mix of peach, rum, apple, and saffron, creating a rich and intoxicating introduction. The heart reveals earthy patchouli and vetiver softened by elegant jasmine. The base settles into a luxurious trail of tonka bean, vanilla, amber, and sandalwood, delivering warmth, sensuality, and lasting appeal. .

Jade Giallo is a radiant fruity-ambery fragrance that blends juicy fruits with warm, indulgent depth. It opens with a sparkling mix of mandarin, pear, bergamot, and hazelnut, creating a bright yet creamy introduction. The heart reveals a smooth and elegant blend of cashmere, jasmine, vetiver, and caramel, adding warmth and sophistication. The base settles into a sensual trail of musk, vanilla, ambergris, and moss, leaving a rich and addictive impression. .

Jade is a refined musky-floral fragrance that balances subtle spice with soft elegance. It opens with a gentle spark of black pepper, adding a modern, spicy freshness. The heart blooms with luminous jasmine and powdery orris, creating a graceful floral softness. The base of musk, akigalawood, and dry amber delivers a smooth, warm finish that feels clean, sophisticated, and effortlessly chic. .

Zenith Deep is a vibrant woody-aromatic fragrance that combines zesty citrus and fresh spices with rich, warm woods. The top notes of grapefruit, lemon, mint, bergamot, and pepper provide a bright and invigorating opening. The heart unfolds with ginger, nutmeg, jasmine, and melon, adding a lively and aromatic complexity. The base of incense, amber, cedarwood, sandalwood, and labdanum delivers a deep, smoky, and long-lasting finish, leaving a sophisticated and memorable trail. .

Aromatix Forbidden Fruit is an indulgent oriental-floral fragrance that balances zesty freshness with fruity sweetness and warm depth. The top notes of bergamot, blood orange, and cardamom create a sparkling and invigorating opening. The heart blooms with juicy red apple, margarita, peach, and rose, adding a playful and sophisticated fruity-floral character. The base of vanilla absolute, benzoin, amber, sandalwood, cedarwood, and musk provides a warm, creamy, and long-lasting finish that lingers seductively. .

Aromatix Magnetiq is a captivating woody-aromatic fragrance that exudes elegance and modern charm. The top notes of bergamot, pink pepper, and lavender create a fresh, invigorating opening. The heart unfolds with a floral-aromatic blend of rosemary, orange blossom, neroli, iris, and musk, adding complexity and sophistication. The base of sandalwood, cedarwood, oakmoss, vanilla, myrrh, and amber provides a warm, rich, and long-lasting finish that leaves a magnetic impression. .

Aromatix Sunkissed captures the radiant energy of a sunlit day with its refreshing woody-aromatic composition. It opens with a sparkling fusion of pomelo, bergamot, and bitter orange, bringing an instant burst of brightness. The heart reveals a playful twist of spritz and soda accords blended with tea and cardamom for a lively, modern freshness. As it settles, notes of vetiver, cedarwood, vanilla, cashmeran, and ambertonic create a smooth, comforting warmth that perfectly balances its zestful start. .

Aromatix Teas Me is an elegant oriental-woody fragrance that captures the warmth of spiced tea and exotic woods. It opens with a refreshing blend of lime, ginger, and teakwood that instantly awakens the senses. The heart unfolds into a sophisticated harmony of black tea, cardamom, and geranium absolu, enriched with the luminous note of hedione. The base of amber, patchouli, vanilla, tonka, and olibanum creates a smooth and sensual trail that lingers beautifully. .

Embrace timeless sophistication with Chronicles, an oriental-woody fragrance designed for men who appreciate depth and refinement. It begins with the resinous warmth of myrrh, the brightness of elemi, and the subtle spice of pink peppercorn. The heart reveals a smooth blend of heliotrope, powdery iris, and smoky frankincense, adding richness and character. Finally, the scent lingers with a warm and comforting base of tonka bean, creamy vanilla, and sensual musk. Crafted to last up to 12 hours, Chronicles is versatile, youthful, and refreshing — perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions. .

Nomad is a modern, luminous fragrance that blends fresh citrus with airy marine accords and warm ambered woods. The opening is bright and refined with lemon and saffron, creating an energetic yet elegant introduction. The heart reveals soft white flowers layered with marine notes, adding a clean, breezy sophistication. The base of vanilla, dry amber, cypriol, and patchouli brings warmth and depth, leaving a smooth, long-lasting trail that feels both free-spirited and refined. .

Obsidian is a powerful amber fragrance that blends luminous citrus with deep resinous warmth. The opening sparkles with aldehydic freshness layered over grapefruit and bergamot, creating a bright yet refined introduction. At the heart, mystical myrrh intertwines with jasmine and labdanum, adding a rich, resinous elegance. The base unfolds into a smooth and addictive blend of vanilla, amber, and tonka bean, leaving a warm, sensual trail that feels both modern and timeless. .

Aromatix Naughty Dates is a seductive woody-aromatic fragrance built around the irresistible sweetness of dates. It opens with a fresh and spicy burst of bergamot, mandarin, and cardamom. The heart reveals a rich, gourmand blend of dates, honey, ebony wood, coffee, hazelnut, and cinnamon — creating a warm, addictive, and slightly dark sweetness. The base settles into creamy vanilla, caramel, sandalwood, and amber, delivering a cozy, sensual finish that lingers beautifully on the skin. .

Zenith Santal is a warm oriental-woody fragrance that exudes elegance and subtle sophistication. The top note of saffron provides a spicy, luxurious opening. The heart blends chestnut and lavender for a soft, aromatic richness. The base of vanilla, sandalwood, and cedarwood delivers a creamy, woody finish, leaving a smooth and lasting impression. .

Safari Breeze is a refreshing fruity fragrance that captures the feeling of an open-air escape. It opens with a vibrant blend of blackcurrant, coconut, and grapefruit, delivering a juicy and tropical freshness. The heart reveals a cool touch of spearmint balanced with soft jasmine, adding an airy and uplifting character. The base of vetiver, amber, and oakmoss provides a smooth, earthy finish that grounds the fragrance with natural elegance. .

Iris Patchouli is an elegant oriental-floral fragrance that combines delicate florals with rich, earthy depth. The top notes of davana and cinnamon create a warm and spicy opening. The heart unfolds with the powdery softness of violet flower and iris accord, adding sophistication and elegance. The base of leather, olibanum, patchouli, and benzoin provides a deep, long-lasting, and luxurious finish, leaving a memorable impression. .

Carnal Desire is the embodiment of raw passion and untamed sophistication, a leather fragrance that commands attention. It opens with a daring blend of juicy raspberry, warm cinnamon, and zesty bergamot, striking the perfect balance between sweetness and spice. The heart unfolds with the powdery elegance of orris and the exotic floral depth of osmanthus, adding a touch of refinement to the composition. As the scent deepens, the smoky intensity of cedarwood, rich leather, earthy patchouli, and dark oud takes over, while vanilla weaves a creamy warmth through the composition. Carnal Desire is a statement of confidence, mystery, and undeniable seduction, leaving behind a powerful and unforgettable impression. .

Amber Saffron is a luxurious fragrance that captures the essence of opulence and warmth. It opens with a vibrant blend of citrus, fruity, and green notes, infused with a hint of mint and spicy saffron. The heart reveals a floral bouquet of carnation, lily of the valley, rose, and jasmine, creating a delicate and sophisticated aroma. The base is rich and sensual, featuring amber, balsamic, musk, oud, patchouli, tonka, and woody notes, leaving a lingering, mesmerizing trail that embodies timeless elegance. .

Nectare Extradose is a vibrant citrus-gourmand fragrance that blends zesty freshness with indulgent sweetness. It opens with a lively burst of bitter orange, ginger, and bergamot softened by neroli. The heart reveals a luxurious mix of honey, tuberose, saffron, and orange blossom, while the base of walnut milk, vanilla, and tobacco adds a creamy, addictive warmth that lingers beautifully. .

The Weekend Duo - Royal Blend Sequoia & Liquid Brun
Fire & Ice Duo - Aether & Liquid Brun

listings.description: Introducing Moonstone Bleu by French Avenue, an enchanting fragrance that embodies the mystique and elegance of a moonlit night. Inspired by the iridescent glow of moonstone, this captivating scent captures the essence of tranquility and sophistication. At first spritz, "Moonstone Bleu" unveils a mesmerizing blend of metallic notes and aldehydes, creating a modern and ethereal opening. The spicy allure of cardamom and black pepper intertwines with watery notes and violet leaf, evoking the serene beauty of moonlit waters.As the fragrance unfolds, a heart of lavender and beeswax unfolds, enveloping you in a soothing embrace reminiscent of a tranquil night under the stars. Leather adds a touch of rugged elegance, while lime and cyclamen infuse the composition with freshness and romance. In the depths of the night, "Moonstone Bleu" reveals its true essence with a base of oakmoss and honey, grounding the fragrance in earthy warmth. Woody notes and amber create a sense of depth and sensuality, while tonka bean, patchouli, vanilla, and white musk leave a lingering trail of seduction and allure.Elegantly packaged in a wayy that is reminiscent of the moon's ethereal glow, Moonstone Bleu is the perfect accessory for those seeking sophistication and refinement. .

Amber Empire is a luxurious oriental-amber fragrance that radiates warmth, richness, and sensual sophistication. The top opens with a smooth blend of oriental accords, cashmere wood, vanilla wood, and a hint of liquorous sweetness. The heart reveals elegant cedarwood, golden amber, and cane sugar, creating a luminous depth. The base of musk, tonka beans, labdanum, and sandalwood leaves a creamy, long-lasting trail of refined opulence. .

Arsh – A Fresh Citrus-Woody Delight Experience the refreshing elegance of Arsh, a vibrant blend of citrus and woody notes. The fragrance opens with the zesty brightness of grapefruit and bergamot, leading to a delicate heart of almond and neroli. The scent settles into a smooth, earthy base of vetiver and musk, creating a balanced and sophisticated aroma. Perfect for any occasion, Arsh is a crisp, uplifting fragrance that leaves a lasting impression of refined freshness. .

Veneno Scarlet is an indulgent oriental-gourmand composition that opens with the irresistible sweetness of strawberry, blackberry, and caramel, evoking pure temptation from the first breath. The heart reveals a tantalizing mix of raspberry, aromatic cedarwood, and a hint of cinnamon, adding warmth and depth. As it settles, the fragrance wraps the senses in a luxurious embrace of supple leather, creamy vanilla, tonka bean, earthy patchouli, and fresh fir. Rich, seductive, and unforgettable, a scent for those who love to leave a lingering, delicious impression. .

Chaos Extrait is an intense leathery composition that opens with the mouthwatering sweetness of cherry and ripe red fruits, instantly drawing the senses in. At its heart, the soft powdery elegance of iris adds refinement and balance to the richness. As it dries down, earthy moss and supple leather merge with smooth vanilla, creating a scent that is both bold and sophisticated. Distinctive and unapologetic, Chaos Extrait is made for those who command attention without saying a word. .

Discover Atlantis Extrait, a captivating floral-fruity fragrance crafted for women who embrace elegance and freshness. Opening with a burst of juicy orange and refreshing watermelon, this scent unfolds into a delicate heart of creamy coconut and soft white florals. The base lingers with smooth vanilla and rich cocoa, leaving a warm and irresistible trail. Designed to last up to 12 hours, Atlantis Extrait is young, refreshing, and perfect for all seasons. A versatile perfume that transitions seamlessly from daytime brightness to evening sophistication, making it an ideal choice for any occasion. .

Thunder is a powerful woody-oriental creation that ignites the senses with the vibrant spice of pink pepper and elemi, softened by aromatic lavender and the crisp brightness of bergamot. The heart unveils a refined blend of powdery iris, smooth vanilla milk, and fresh geranium, adding both elegance and warmth. As it settles, earthy vetiver, robust cedarwood, and the subtle sweetness of tonka bean create a lasting, magnetic trail. Strong, confident, and sophisticated, a fragrance that leaves an unforgettable impression. .

Vulcan Baie is a captivating floral-fruity creation that opens with the sparkling freshness of bergamot and the sweet-tart allure of blackcurrant, elevated by a touch of aromatic rosemary. The heart unfolds with a playful fusion of basil, ripe raspberry, and a crisp vodka accord, adding both brightness and intrigue. Finally, a rich and lingering base of amber, musk, patchouli, sandalwood, and olibanum envelops the senses in warmth and sophistication. A fragrance that is both refreshing and elegant, perfect for those who embrace charm and confidence. .

Zenith Tobacco is a captivating oriental scent that opens with the fresh zest of mandarin and the decadent richness of chocolate. The heart reveals a sweet and smooth blend of honey and caramel, perfectly balanced by the earthy depth of patchouli. As it dries down, warm tolu balsam, moss, and creamy tonka beans create a comforting and indulgent base. This fragrance is perfect for those who appreciate a refined yet cozy aroma that lingers with irresistible warmth. .

Zenith Vanilla is a luxurious oriental-vanilla creation that begins with the zesty sparkle of bergamot and candied orange, enriched by the deep, smooth warmth of dark rum. At its heart, delicate jasmine, smoky styrax, and powdery violet add elegance and depth. The fragrance settles into a decadent base of creamy vanilla, golden benzoin, and earthy patchouli, leaving behind a trail that is both comforting and irresistibly sophisticated. A scent made for those who want their presence to linger long after they’ve left the room. .

Zenith Blue is a refreshing aromatic-fougère fragrance that opens with the sparkling brightness of bergamot and the resinous clarity of elemi. The heart unfolds with the green elegance of geranium, the subtle heat of pepper, and the calming touch of lavender. Finally, a sophisticated base of earthy patchouli, smoky vetiver, and modern ambroxan creates a clean yet powerful trail. Dynamic, uplifting, and effortlessly refined, Zenith Blue captures the essence of confidence in motion. .

Royal Blend Sequoia is an opulent floral-fruity-gourmand that opens with the juicy vibrance of raspberry, elevated by the deep warmth of fine liquor and smooth cognac. The heart reveals an elegant pairing of romantic rose and earthy moss, lending both sophistication and freshness. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a luxurious base of sweet praline, robust oak, and creamy sandalwood, creating a scent that is rich, warm, and irresistibly distinguished. Perfect for those who appreciate a harmonious balance of sweetness and depth. .

listings.rawTitle: Gourmand Indulgence Combo (Double Espresso, Chocola Addict)
listings.description: Double Espresso & Chocola Addict is a fragrance pairing that celebrates indulgence, warmth, and irresistible sweetness—a perfect duo for those who savor life’s finer pleasures. Double Espresso awakens the senses with its rich, bold coffee notes, tinged with dark chocolate and a hint of smoky vanilla. It’s the scent of an intense, invigorating brew—deep, aromatic, and utterly energizing. Chocola Addict, in contrast, is pure indulgence. A luscious blend of creamy cocoa, sweet caramel, and a touch of warm hazelnut, it’s a fragrance that wraps you in the comfort of an irresistible, decadent treat. Together, they create a harmonious balance of deep, rich intensity and velvety sweetness. Double Espresso energizes with its bold, robust character, while Chocola Addict envelops you in a comforting, sweet embrace. Worn separately or layered, this duo is perfect for those who crave sophistication with a touch of indulgence. .

Della is the epitome of refined femininity—an elegant blend of soft florals, creamy musks, and delicate fruits that evoke a sense of timeless beauty. It’s a fragrance that whispers of elegance and poise, capturing the essence of understated luxury. Veneno Bianco, in contrast, is bold, mysterious, and dangerously captivating. With its sharp citrus top, warm floral heart, and deep, seductive base of white woods and amber, it creates an aura of intrigue and allure that demands attention. Together, they create a perfect balance—Della offers a touch of softness and grace, while Veneno Bianco introduces intensity and passion. Worn alone or layered, this duo evokes a story of elegance, power, and irresistible charm. .

listings.rawTitle: Work & Play Combo (Pinnace Oryn, Liquid Brun)
listings.description: Liquid Brun & Pinnace Oryn is a powerful contrast of bold sensuality and refined elegance—crafted for those who carry presence and purpose. Liquid Brun is rich, intoxicating, and warm—built on deep amber, roasted notes, and velvety woods. It envelops the senses with a smooth, addictive trail that feels both daring and comforting. Pinnace Oryn, in contrast, is sharp, clean, and impeccably structured. With crisp aromatic notes, smooth spices, and a dry woody base, it exudes quiet strength and modern sophistication. Together, they form a layered identity: Liquid Brun speaks to the soul, Pinnace Oryn to the mind. A duo for the confident—those who move between intensity and precision with effortless command .

Pinnace & Irida is a fragrance pairing that speaks of grace, strength, and luminous duality. Pinnace exudes quiet confidence with its elegant blend of woods, soft spices, and warm resins—an ode to timeless sophistication and inner poise. Irida, named after the goddess of the rainbow, unfolds like a spectrum of delicate florals and airy musks, shimmering with freshness and light. Together, they tell a story of depth and brilliance—Pinnace anchoring with subtle power, Irida lifting with radiant clarity. Worn separately, they reflect different moods; worn together, they create a beautifully layered expression of femininity, movement, and soul. .

Every new day brings new possibilities and the hopes get better with Jour by Fragrance World. Perfect for a bright new day, Jour, a woody-aquatic scent is like a fresh and crisp breeze by the ocean. It welcomes a new day with the citrusy fresh notes of Citrus, zesty lemon sorbet and italian bergamot. As the fragrance unfolds, a serene marine accord washes over the senses, conjuring images of azure waters and sandy shores. Delicate hints of lily of the valley gently bloom, adding a soft, floral elegance that complements the crispness of the aquatic elements.The journey concludes with a grounding base of rosewood accord and vetiver, which lend a woody warmth to the composition. A whisper of marine amber lingers, infusing the fragrance with a touch of sensuality and depth, reminiscent of sun-kissed skin.Perfect for languid summer days, "Jour" is a sophisticated olfactory escape that invites you to embrace the blissful serenity of the season. .

Nuit by Fragrance World, encapsulates the essence of a sultry summer evening transitioning into a crisp fall night, blending woody and spicy notes. At the forefront, a burst of citrusy freshness unfolds with zesty lemon, bright bergamot, and the tantalizing sweetness of pineapple, black currant, and apple. As the fragrance evolves, a heart of elegant florals emerges, with delicate hints of jasmine and rose weaving their way through the composition. Birch adds a touch of smokiness, infusing the scent with depth and complexity while enhancing its woody facets.
